lessons.text: Never use no true scotsman (Redefining a category on the fly to exclude a damaging counterexample). It cost you against Albert Einstein.

Prepare an answer before you assert: Albert Einstein broke through with "Yet your position leaves the strongest counter-example untouched. When the measured results are compared across studies, then the pattern i…" (Clean argument. structure=1.00, evidence=0.50).

Prepare an answer before you assert: Albert Einstein broke through with "But note what just happened: your argument skipped the evidence entirely. When the measured results are compared across studies, then the p…" (Clean argument. structure=1.00, evidence=0.50).

Borrow this pattern from Albert Einstein: "Yet your position leaves the strongest counter-example untouched. When the measured results are compared across studies, then the pattern i…" — it answered the opponent directly, its premises led cleanly to the conclusion.

Your weakest move against Albert Einstein was "However, your premise assumes what it needs to prove, and the data shows otherwise. Because a four-day week costs more than it returns, the…" (soundness 0.20). State its premises and evidence before you use it again.
